name: @able/desk
description: Able Desk: an agent-native support desk and CRM on Cloudflare Workers.

ABLE_OPERATOR_HOSTNAME.description: Bare dedicated operator hostname carrying both /mcp and /ops behind one domain-wide Cloudflare Access application.

CF_ACCESS_AUD.description: Cloudflare Access application audience for the dedicated operator hostname.

CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Access issuer host, such as your-team.cloudflareaccess.com.

ABLE_OWNER_EMAIL.description: The first Access-approved operator who should become the workspace administrator.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: The secret for the Turnstile widget protecting public portal writes.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: The matching Turnstile site key rendered by the public portal.

CUSTOMER_CAPABILITY_SECRET.description: A random value of at least 32 characters used to derive per-case customer capabilities.

WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN.description: A private random token that Meta must echo during WhatsApp webhook verification.

WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET.description: The Meta app secret used to verify WhatsApp webhook request signatures.

WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: A least-authority Meta system-user token for sending through the WhatsApp Cloud API.

WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.description: The Meta phone-number ID for this deployment's WhatsApp sender.

WHATSAPP_WABA_ID.description: The WhatsApp Business Account ID accepted by this deployment's webhook.

SHOPIFY_CUSTOMER_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Customer Account API public client ID enabling store-account sign-in on the support portal.

SHOPIFY_UCP_AGENT_PROFILE_URL.description: Optional public Able UCP profile URL for local parity; deployed agents derive /.well-known/ucp from the portal origin.

SHOPIFY_STOREFRONT_COUNTRY.description: Optional ISO country code used to localize public Shopify prices and availability, such as IN.

SHOPIFY_STOREFRONT_LANGUAGE.description: Optional BCP 47 language tag used to localize public storefront content, such as en or hi.

ABLE_VOICE_KEYTERMS.description: Optional comma-separated product, brand, and place vocabulary boosted by voice recognition.

scripts.build:assets: npm run build:mcp-app && npm run build:voice-demo && npm run build:portal-search
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/require-main-build.mjs && npm run build:production-config && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.production.generated.json && npm run build:assets && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.generated.json
scripts.check:generated: git diff --exit-code -- src/adapters/mcp/app.generated.ts public/voice-demo.js public/voice-demo.css public/portal-search.js
scripts.check: npm run build:assets && npm run check:generated && npm run types && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:mcp-app && npm run typecheck:voice-demo && npm run typecheck:portal-search && npm run typecheck:voice-eval && npm run test
